title: Left-coefficient counit projection: transpose, unit and associativity
statement:
Use monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category] with associator $\alpha:(U\otimes V)\otimes W\to U\otimes(V\otimes W)$ and left unitor $\lambda$. A strong monoidal functor has the structure of [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor]; write $\delta^H_{U,V}:H(U\otimes V)\xrightarrow{\sim}HU\otimes HV$ and $e_H:H\mathbf1\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf1$ for its inverse structure maps. Set $h^H_N=\lambda_N\circ(e_H\otimes1_N)$ and $a^H_{B,B',N}=\alpha_{HB,HB',N}\circ(\delta^H_{B,B'}\otimes1_N)$. Composition is right to left.
A symmetry $\beta_{U,V}:U\otimes V\xrightarrow{\sim}V\otimes U$ means natural involutive tensor swaps satisfying the hexagon identities with $\alpha$; a symmetric strong monoidal functor preserves these swaps under $\delta$.
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be symmetric monoidal categories and $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ a symmetric strong monoidal functor. Let $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be right adjoint to $F$, with natural Hom bijections $\operatorname{Hom}(FU,V)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(U,RV)$ and counit $\varepsilon_V:FRV\to V$ in the convention of [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. For arbitrary $N\in\mathcal D$ and $B\in\mathcal C$, define $\rho_{N,B}:RN\otimes B\to R(N\otimes FB)$ as the adjunct of $(\varepsilon_N\otimes1_{FB})\circ\delta^F_{RN,B}$, and define
$$t_{B,N}=R(\beta_{N,FB})\circ\rho_{N,B}\circ\beta_{B,RN}:B\otimes RN\longrightarrow R(FB\otimes N).$$
Then $t$ is natural in both arguments, its transpose is exactly
$$\varepsilon_{FB\otimes N}\circ F(t_{B,N})=(1_{FB}\otimes\varepsilon_N)\circ\delta^F_{B,RN},$$
and for all $B,B'\in\mathcal C$ and $N\in\mathcal D$ it satisfies
$$R(h^F_N)\circ t_{\mathbf1,N}=\lambda_{RN},$$
$$R(a^F_{B,B',N})\circ t_{B\otimes B',N}=t_{B,FB'\otimes N}\circ(1_B\otimes t_{B',N})\circ\alpha_{B,B',RN}.$$
No component of $\rho$ or $t$ is assumed invertible.

proof.text:
Write $d_{U,V}=\delta^F_{U,V}$ and $e=e_F$. By [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection], the transpose of $v:U\to RV$ is $T(v)=\varepsilon_V\circ F(v)$; $T$ is a bijection. For $a:U'\to U$ and $b:V\to V'$, naturality gives $T(R(b)\circ v\circ a)=b\circ T(v)\circ F(a)$. The defining adjunct for $\rho$ therefore gives
$$T(t_{B,N})=\beta_{N,FB}\circ(\varepsilon_N\otimes1)\circ d_{RN,B}\circ F(\beta_{B,RN}).$$
Naturality of the symmetry rewrites the first two factors as $(1\otimes\varepsilon_N)\circ\beta_{FRN,FB}$. Preservation of the symmetry by $F$ says $d_{RN,B}\circ F(\beta_{B,RN})=\beta_{FB,FRN}\circ d_{B,RN}$. The two adjacent swaps cancel by involutivity. Thus
$$T(t_{B,N})=(1_{FB}\otimes\varepsilon_N)\circ d_{B,RN}.$$
This proves the required transpose identity directly from the defined symmetry conjugate, without assuming that $\rho$ or $t$ is invertible.

proof.text:
For $f:B\to C$ and $g:N\to M$, compare $R(F(f)\otimes g)\circ t_{B,N}$ and $t_{C,M}\circ(f\otimes R(g))$. Step 1 gives the transpose of the first as $(F(f)\otimes g)\circ(1\otimes\varepsilon_N)\circ d_{B,RN}$. The transpose of the second is
$$(1\otimes\varepsilon_M)\circ d_{C,RM}\circ F(f\otimes R(g))
=(F(f)\otimes(\varepsilon_M\circ FR(g)))\circ d_{B,RN}
=(F(f)\otimes(g\circ\varepsilon_N))\circ d_{B,RN}.$$
The first equality is tensorator naturality in [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor] and tensor bifunctoriality in [def-sfb-monoidal-category]; the second is counit naturality in [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. Bifunctoriality identifies this with the first transpose. Injectivity of $T$ proves joint naturality, and setting either $f$ or $g$ equal to the identity gives naturality in each argument.

source.place: Agent calculation, step 2; Tag 0037 (definition-adjoint and following transpose formulas), Tags 0FFK/0FFL (definition-monoidal-category, definition-functor-monoidal-categories); projection construction Tag 0B56 in sites-cohomology.tex.

proof.text:
The left unit axiom in [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor], composed with the inverses of its structure isomorphisms, is
$$F(\lambda_X)=\lambda_{FX}\circ(e\otimes1_{FX})\circ d_{\mathbf1,X}.$$
Put $X=RN$. By Step 1 and naturality of transposition, the transpose of $R(h^F_N)\circ t_{\mathbf1,N}$ is
$$\lambda_N\circ(e\otimes1_N)\circ(1_{F\mathbf1}\otimes\varepsilon_N)\circ d_{\mathbf1,RN}
=\varepsilon_N\circ\lambda_{FRN}\circ(e\otimes1_{FRN})\circ d_{\mathbf1,RN}
=\varepsilon_N\circ F(\lambda_{RN}).$$
The first equality uses tensor bifunctoriality and naturality of the left unitor from [def-sfb-monoidal-category]; the second is the displayed unit axiom. The result is $T(\lambda_{RN})$ by [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. Injectivity of $T$ proves the unit equation.

source.place: Agent calculation, step 3; Tag 0037 (definition-adjoint and following transpose formulas), Tags 0FFK/0FFL (definition-monoidal-category, definition-functor-monoidal-categories); projection construction Tag 0B56 in sites-cohomology.tex.

proof.text:
For associativity put $X=RN$, $M=FB'\otimes N$, $c=t_{B',N}$ and $A=\alpha_{B,B',X}$. All maps below have source $F((B\otimes B')\otimes X)$ and target $FB\otimes(FB'\otimes N)$. Step 1 gives the transpose of the right side of the desired equation as
$$(1_{FB}\otimes\varepsilon_M)\circ d_{B,RM}\circ F(1_B\otimes c)\circ F(A).$$
Tensorator naturality rewrites this as
$$(1_{FB}\otimes(\varepsilon_M\circ F(c)))\circ d_{B,B'\otimes X}\circ F(A).$$
Applying Step 1 to $c=t_{B',N}$ replaces $\varepsilon_M\circ F(c)$ by $(1_{FB'}\otimes\varepsilon_N)\circ d_{B',X}$. Hence this transpose equals
$$Q=(1_{FB}\otimes(1_{FB'}\otimes\varepsilon_N))\circ(1_{FB}\otimes d_{B',X})\circ d_{B,B'\otimes X}\circ F(A).$$
These are just naturality of the inverse tensorator from [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor], tensor bifunctoriality from [def-sfb-monoidal-category], and the natural transpose formula of [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection].

source.place: Agent calculation, step 4; Tag 0037 (definition-adjoint and following transpose formulas), Tags 0FFK/0FFL (definition-monoidal-category, definition-functor-monoidal-categories); projection construction Tag 0B56 in sites-cohomology.tex.

proof.text:
The transpose of the left side is, by Step 1,
$$\alpha_{FB,FB',N}\circ(d_{B,B'}\otimes1_N)\circ(1_{F(B\otimes B')}\otimes\varepsilon_N)\circ d_{B\otimes B',X}.$$
Tensor bifunctoriality and naturality of the associator from [def-sfb-monoidal-category] rewrite it as
$$(1_{FB}\otimes(1_{FB'}\otimes\varepsilon_N))\circ\alpha_{FB,FB',FX}\circ(d_{B,B'}\otimes1_{FX})\circ d_{B\otimes B',X}.$$
The associativity axiom in [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor], with its invertible tensorators cancelled, says exactly
$$\alpha_{FB,FB',FX}\circ(d_{B,B'}\otimes1_{FX})\circ d_{B\otimes B',X}
=(1_{FB}\otimes d_{B',X})\circ d_{B,B'\otimes X}\circ F(\alpha_{B,B',X}).$$
Substitution makes this transpose $Q$ from Step 4. Injectivity of the Hom bijection [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection] proves the associativity equation. Only the given structural isomorphisms of $F$ were cancelled; no cancellation of a projection component occurred.

lean.statement: theorem leftCoefficientProjectionMap_coherence (adj : F ⊣ R) : (∀ (B B' : C) (N N' : D) (f : B ⟶ B') (g : N ⟶ N'), leftCoefficientProjectionMap adj B N ≫ R.map (F.map f ⊗ₘ g) = (f ⊗ₘ R.map g) ≫ leftCoefficientProjectionMap adj B' N') ∧ (∀ (B : C) (N : D), F.map (leftCoefficientProjectionMap adj B N) ≫ adj.counit.app (F.obj B ⊗ N) = Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F B (R.obj N) ≫ (𝟙 (F.obj B) ⊗ₘ adj.counit.app N)) ∧ (∀ (N : D), leftCoefficientProjectionMap adj (𝟙_ C) N ≫ R.map ((Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η F ⊗ₘ 𝟙 N) ≫ (λ_ N).hom) = (λ_ (R.obj N)).hom) ∧ (∀ (B B' : C) (N : D), leftCoefficientProjectionMap adj (B ⊗ B') N ≫ R.map ((Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F B B' ⊗ₘ 𝟙 N) ≫ (α_ (F.obj B) (F.obj B') N).hom) = (α_ B B' (R.obj N)).hom ≫ (𝟙 B ⊗ₘ leftCoefficientProjectionMap adj B' N) ≫ leftCoefficientProjectionMap adj B (F.obj B' ⊗ N))
